    Yes, Kylian Mbappé has been dealing with a sprain in his left knee, which has sidelined him for several Real Madrid matches, though he's been making good progress and was expected to travel with the squad for their upcoming Champions League match against Manchester City. He's been following a conservative treatment plan, and his return to full fitness is being managed day-by-day, with reports indicating he's feeling better and nearing a comeback, though he missed the first leg against City.
     
    Key Details:
    • Injury: Left knee sprain (a recurrence of an issue from December). 
    • Status: Recovering well, with progress described as "all good news". 
    • Missed Games: Several matches, including Champions League ties. 
    • Return: Expected to be available for the second leg of the Champions League match against Manchester City.
